title: Bodycam: Young Mom Accused of Ditching 4-Year-Old to Get Cosmetic Surgery
description:
A 25-year-old Florida mom was arrested after allegedly leaving her four-year-old son home alone while she got cosmetic surgery in June. Doral police said Jessica Renteria rented an AirBnB in Miami-Dade County to have the procedure done nearby. Security footage from the apartment shows Renteria leaving her home in the morning. Hours later, the child emerged from the residence and began wandering. He was found a few hours later sleeping under a stairwell. Find out what happened to Renteria when police caught up with her on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
